envelope.description: Switch the question comment and pin the other affected callers

body.title: Switch the question comment and pin the other affected callers
body.summary: Change the ghComment call in src/workflow/questions.ts to the adapter with its existing catch kept, and add tests for the other callers of migrated wrappers: setup label creation with a timing-out label create, and listMyOpenTasks with a classified or empty login failure before any search call, with queryTasks left untouched.
acceptanceChecks: questions.ts posts its comment with the same argv and a failed comment is logged in the existing catch
setup ensureLabels records a timed-out label as failed and continues
listMyOpenTasks propagates a login failure as a thrown Error before any search call and the empty-login message still matches /no login/

tests.name: src/workflow/__tests__/questions.test.ts: the comment goes through the adapter with the same argv and a failure is logged in the existing catch
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/setup.test.ts: ensureLabels with a timing-out label create records the label as failed and continues
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/tasks.test.ts: listMyOpenTasks propagates a classified or empty login failure before any search call
src/workflow/tracker/__tests__/tasks.test.ts: queryTasks keeps its current execution path and results
